messages.Auto Flow Rate Calibration utilizes Bamb:
Auto Flow Rate Calibration utilizes Bambu Lab's Micro-Lidar technology, directly measuring the calibration patterns. However, please be advised that the efficacy and accuracy of this method may be compromised with specific types of materials. Particularly, filaments that are transparent or semi-transparent, have sparkles, or have a highly-reflective finish may not be suitable for this calibration and can produce less-than-desirable results.

The calibration results may vary between each calibration or filament. We are still improving the accuracy and compatibility of this calibration through firmware updates over time.

Caution: Flow Rate Calibration is an advanced process, to be attempted only by those who fully understand its purpose and implications. Incorrect usage can lead to sub-par prints or printer damage. Please make sure to carefully read and understand the process before doing it.

messages.If smooth or traditional mode is selecte: If smooth or traditional mode is selected, a timelapse video will be generated for each print. After each layer is printed, a snapshot is taken with the chamber camera. All of these snapshots are composed into a timelapse video when printing completes. If smooth mode is selected, the toolhead will move to the excess chute after each layer is printed and then take a snapshot. Since the melt filament may leak from the nozzle during the process of taking a snapshot, a prime tower is required for smooth mode to wipe the nozzle.

messages.The firmware version is abnormal. Repair: The firmware version is abnormal. Repairing and updating are required before printing. Do you want to update now? You can also update later on the printer or update next time you start EdgeSlicer.
messages.The length of fast retraction before wip: This is the length of fast retraction before a wipe, relative to retraction length.
messages.The localization tag of build plate is d: The localization tag of the build plate will be detected, and printing will be paused if the tag is not in predefined range.
messages.The material softens at this temperature: The material softens at this temperature, so when the bed temperature is equal to or greater than this, it's highly recommended to open the front door and/or remove the upper glass to avoid clogs.
messages.The metallic material of nozzle. This de: The metallic material of the nozzle: This determines the abrasive resistance of the nozzle and what kind of filament can be printed.
messages.The model was not found, please reselect: The model was not found; please reselect vendor.
The name field is not allowed to be empty.
messages.The name is not allowed to end with spac: The name is not allowed to end with a space.
messages.The name is not allowed to start with sp: The name is not allowed to start with a space.
messages.The name may show garbage characters!: Because of unsupported text encoding, garbage characters may appear!
messages.The nozzle diameter was not found, pleas: The nozzle diameter was not found; please reselect.
messages.The nozzle hardness required by the fila: The nozzle hardness required by the filament is higher than the default nozzle hardness of the printer. Please replace the hardened nozzle or filament, otherwise, the nozzle will be worn down or damaged.
messages.The nozzle's hardness. Zero means no che: The nozzle's hardness. Zero means no checking for nozzle hardness during slicing.
messages.The number of bottom solid layers is inc: The number of bottom solid layers is increased when slicing if the thickness calculated by bottom shell layers is thinner than this value. This can avoid having too thin a shell when layer height is small. 0 means that this setting is disabled and the thickness of the bottom shell is determined simply by the number of bottom shell layers.
messages.The number of top solid layers is increa: The number of top solid layers is increased when slicing if the thickness calculated by top shell layers is thinner than this value. This can avoid having too thin a shell when layer height is small. 0 means that this setting is disabled and thickness of top shell is determined simply by the number of top shell layers.

 Do you want to scale to millimeters?
messages.The player is not loaded, please click \: The player is not loaded; please click the "play" button to retry.
messages.The prime tower is not supported in \"By: A prime tower is not supported in “By object” print.
messages.The prime tower is not supported when ad: A prime tower is not supported when adaptive layer height is on. It requires that all objects have the same layer height.
messages.The prime tower requires \"support gap\": A prime tower requires any “support gap” to be a multiple of layer height.
messages.The prime tower requires that all object: A prime tower requires that all objects are printed over the same number of raft layers.
A prime tower requires that all objects are sliced with the same layer height.
A prime tower requires that all objects have the same layer height.
messages.The prime tower requires that support ha: A prime tower requires that support has the same layer height as the object.
messages.The printer does not support sending to: The printer does not support sending to printer MicroSD card.
messages.The printer is busy on other print job: The printer is busy with another print job.
messages.The printer is required to be in the sam: The printer is required to be on the same LAN as EdgeSlicer.
messages.The printer preset was not found, please: The printer preset was not found; please reselect.
messages.The printer preset you created already h:
The printer preset you created already has a preset with the same name. Do you want to overwrite it?
	Yes: Overwrite the printer preset with the same name, and filament and process presets with the same preset name will be recreated 
and filament and process presets without the same preset name will be reserved.
	Cancel: Do not create a preset; return to the creation interface.
messages.The selected file contains several disjo: The selected file contains several disjointed areas. This is not supported.
messages.The spiral vase mode does not work when: Spiral (vase) mode does not work when an object contains more than one material.
messages.The start and end points which is from c: The start and end points which are from the cutter area to the excess chute.
messages.The start position to print each part of: This is the starting position for each part of the outer wall.
messages.The supplied file couldn't be read becau: The supplied file couldn't be read because it's empty.
messages.The type of the last solid object part i: The type of the last solid object part cannot be changed.
messages.The vendor cannot be a number. Please re: The vendor cannot be a number; please re-enter.
messages.The volume of material to prime extruder: This is the volume of material to prime the extruder with on the tower.
messages.The width within which to jitter. It's a: The width of jittering: it’s recommended to keep this lower than the outer wall line width.
messages.The wiping tower can be used to clean up: The wiping tower can be used to clean up residue on the nozzle and stabilize the chamber pressure inside the nozzle in order to avoid appearance defects when printing objects.
messages.There are some unknown filaments in the: There are some unknown filaments in the AMS mappings. Please check whether they are the required filaments. If they are okay, click "Confirm" to start printing.
messages.There is already a historical calibratio: There is already a previous calibration result with the same name: %s. Only one result with a name is saved. Are you sure you want to overwrite the previous result?
messages.There may be escape characters in the ve: There may be disallowed characters in the vendor or serial input of the filament. Please delete and re-enter.
messages.This action will break a cut corresponde:
This action will break a cut correspondence.
After that, model consistency can't be guaranteed.

To manipulate with solid parts or negative volumes you have to invalidate cut information first.
messages.This file contains several objects posit:
This file contains several objects positioned at multiple heights.
Instead of considering them as multiple objects, should 
the file be loaded as a single object with multiple parts?
messages.This is the number of solid layers of to: This is the number of solid layers of top shell, including the top surface layer. When the thickness calculated by this value is thinner than the top shell thickness, the top shell layers will be increased

This machine type can only hold 16 historical results per nozzle. You can delete the existing historical results and then start calibration. Or you can continue the calibration, but you cannot create new calibration historical results.

messages.This setting is only used for model size:
This setting is only used for tuning model size by small amounts.
For example, when the model size has small errors or when tolerances are incorrect. For large adjustments, please use the model scale function.

The value will be reset to 0.
messages.This setting stands for how much volume: This setting is the volume of filament that can be melted and extruded per second. Printing speed is limited by max volumetric speed, in case of too high and unreasonable speed setting. This value cannot be zero.
messages.Too large elephant foot compensation is:
The elephant foot compensation value is too large.
If there are significant elephant foot issues, please check other settings.
The bed temperature may be too high, for example.

The value will be reset to 0.

messages.Whenever the retraction is done, the noz: Whenever there is a retraction, the nozzle is lifted a little to create clearance between the nozzle and the print. This prevents the nozzle from hitting the print when traveling more. Using spiral lines to lift z can prevent stringing.
